text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz... Ah?! Ooh, I dozed offagain! I just can't deal with tiny printlike this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Snowy days did see me holed up with<n>a book, but
otherwise I was out<n>pick'n wild greens, or fish'n
by the<n>river—bein' active outdoors is more<n>my
speed.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So I never was all too eager to read...<n>But now?
Sitt'n in a cafe with a book<n>all fancy like—that's the
kinda city girl<n>I wanna be!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All righty, I can do this! Zzz...
